title: Names collide
prompt:
Two customers named Sam: id R1 email sam1@example.test; id R2 email sam2@example.test. Ticket T9 belongs to R2. R1 phone is 555-0111. R2 phone is not given. Extract customer_id,email,phone for T9. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: customer_id, email, phone. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
